Each beat has a `trigger` (campaign_start | island_start:<idx> | stage_start:<lvl> | stage_complete:<lvl> | game_complete), an optional `scene` hint, an optional `background` (AssetLibrary env id), and `lines` [{who: narrator|jamie|jasmine|jinn, pose, text}]. StoryDirector plays the first UNSEEN beat matching a trigger and records it via SaveService so it never repeats. Adding chapters = adding beats here, no code change.

lines.text: The Kingdom of Five Crowns had known only peace.
Another bright morning over Sunlit Falls. Nothing ever changes here... and I love it.
Peace is only a cage that hasn't been rattled, Princess. I have come to rattle it.
Dark fire — guards! Someone — JAMIE!
Scream if it comforts you. Your hero is a village away and a world too late.
Jinn folded into smoke, and Jasmine with him — away through the five kingdoms.
The courtyard's still burning... she's gone. The trail runs into the falls.
Five kingdoms or fifty. I'm bringing her home.
CHAPTER ONE  ·  SUNLIT FALLS  ·  The Forest Kingdom
The woodland's turned against itself. Jinn's magic is in the roots. Cut a path.
A shape of thorn and green light blocks the pass out of the forest.
One of his beasts. Move it, or be moved.
The beast bursts into falling leaves. In the leaves: a shard of Jasmine's tiara, still warm with a spell.
(a whisper in the light)  Jamie... he's taking me north. Into the ice. Hurry.
Frosthaven. Hold on, Jas.
CHAPTER TWO  ·  FROSTHAVEN  ·  The Ice Kingdom
An armoured frost-spectre rises from the frozen river.
Ice against lightning. Bad matchup — for you.
(the signal, stronger)  He's slowing down. The heat ahead is Volcania. Be careful of the smoke that thinks.
Volcania. Every kingdom's worse than the last.
CHAPTER THREE  ·  VOLCANIA  ·  The Fire Kingdom
You are... persistent. Tiresome. Here — a taste of what waits at the end of your little walk.
The mountain answered him. Jamie barely kept his feet.
That was a fraction of it. Just a fraction.
Come to Aurora Reach when you're ready to lose properly.
Still standing. Sand next. Keep moving.
CHAPTER FOUR  ·  SANDORIA  ·  The Desert Kingdom
A sorcerer of chaos and red glass bars the last dune.
(fighting the spell now)  I bought us a moment. Aurora Reach — his stronghold. The crystal at its heart is where he's keeping me.
Last kingdom. Sword, lightning, boots — all of it.
CHAPTER FIVE  ·  AURORA REACH  ·  The Crystal Kingdom
Jasmine hangs in a prison of singing crystal. Jinn stands between.
The whole journey, and for what? To die at the door.
Jamie — don't listen to him. Finish this.
I didn't cross five kingdoms to talk. Let her go, Jinn.
Halfway through the forest. The creatures are getting bolder — and they're all pointed the same way. North.
You move well on ice, little hero. Enjoy it. The next kingdom will melt that confidence off you.
Keep talking. Every word tells me you're still close.
(faint through the heat)  The fire kingdom's guardians answer to him directly now. Don't trust the ground.
Forty kingdoms of servants and you walk through them like a market. No matter. The desert keeps its own.
I can see the crystal spire from here, Jamie. I can see YOU. Almost.
Almost is over. I'm coming up.
The crystal shattered. The dark went out of the five kingdoms all at once, like a held breath let go.
You took your time.
Traffic. Five kingdoms of it.
They walked home the long way, through kingdoms learning to be bright again.
— WE WIN —
